test_title: PYST 36: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 28 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a Central Armed Police Force?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Criminal Investigation Department**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Central Armed Police Forces (CAPFs)** are under the administrative control of the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA), Government of India. They are responsible for safeguarding the internal security of the country.
 
• Examples of CAPFs include the **Indo-Tibetan Border Police (ITBP)**, **Border Security Force (BSF)**, and **Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF)**.
 
• The **Criminal Investigation Department (CID)**, on the other hand, is not a part of the Central Armed Police Forces. It is a state-level law enforcement agency that investigates criminal cases within the state.
 
• The CID is a specialized unit of the state police departments and works under the jurisdiction of the state governments, not the Ministry of Home Affairs.
 
• Thus, among the options provided, the **Criminal Investigation Department** does not fall under the category of Central Armed Police Forces (CAPFs).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indo-Tibetan Border Police (ITBP):**

 
 
• The ITBP was raised in **October 1962** following the Sino-Indian War.
 
• It is primarily responsible for guarding the **India-China border** and ensuring security in the Himalayan region.
 
• The ITBP also handles disaster management and provides relief in areas affected by natural calamities.
 
 
 
• **Border Security Force (BSF):**
 
 
• The BSF was established on **1 December 1965** to secure India's borders with Pakistan and Bangladesh.
 
• It acts as the first line of defense for the country and is involved in border patrolling, preventing illegal activities, and countering infiltration.
 
 
 
• **Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF):**
 
 
• The CRPF was formed in **1939** and is the largest paramilitary force in India.
 
• It is tasked with maintaining internal security, counter-insurgency operations, and assisting state police forces.
 
• The CRPF also manages elections in sensitive areas and ensures the safety of critical infrastructure.
 
 
 
• **Criminal Investigation Department (CID):**
 
 
• The CID was established by the British government in **1902** for investigating and solving major criminal cases.
 
• It operates at the state level and includes specialized branches like the Anti-Human Trafficking Unit, Cyber Crime Unit, and Fingerprint Bureau.
 
• The CID officers are typically state police officers who receive additional training in criminal investigation techniques.
